content_sections.heading: About RLDA
content_sections.text: The Rail Land Development Authority is a Statutory Authority of the Ministry of Railways, constituted in terms of the Extraordinary Gazette Notification dated 31.10.2006, with its office at Konnectus Tower-II, Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi. The notice describes its work as land management and station re-development, contract management, finance management, and valuation and marketing. RLDA projects are presently being developed at Delhi, Chandigarh, Mumbai, Chennai, Lucknow, Nagpur, Secunderabad and other places (illustrative locations), and the notice states that manpower shall be required Pan India.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: RLDA Vacancy Notice No.-24/2026 lists 6 posts across three items. The notice states that the number of posts and locations are indicative and may vary as per requirement of RLDA.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only officers already working in the cadres, pay levels and organisations named for each post can apply, as the posts are filled on deputation. The essential qualification and desirable points for each post are below; the service conditions follow post by post. JGM: Working in analogous posts, or a Group 'A' officer working on regular posts in Pay Level 13 / Level 12 of the IRSSE cadre of Indian Railways, or Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering officers having corresponding grade and 9 years Group 'A' or equivalent service on regular posts in the Signal & Telecom Cadre of Central Government / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities. DGM: Working in analogous posts, or a Group A or Group B Gazetted officer working in a regular post in Pay Level 12 / Level 11 from the Electrical / Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering Cadre of S&T of Indian Railways / Central Govt. / State Govt. / Statutory Authorities. DGM, or: Officers having a Degree in Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics/ Electrical Engineering in the S&T Cadre of Central Govt. / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities with 6 years of service in Group 'A'/ Group 'B' or its equivalent. DGM, or: Officers having a Diploma in Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering of the S&T Cadre of Central Govt. / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities with 15 years' service. For PSU officers, the IDA pay scale equivalents of CDA Level-13/Level-12/Level-11 are E-6 (Rs.90000-240000), E-5 (Rs.80000-220000) and E-4 (Rs.70000-200000). JGM: Working on analogous posts, or a Group 'A' officer working on regular posts in Pay Level 13/ Level 12 of Indian Railways in the Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/S&T Engineering Cadre, and 9 years Group 'A' service or its equivalent on regular basis in the Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/S&T Engineering Cadre of Central Government/State Govt./Indian Railways or its equivalent in PSUs/ Statutory Authorities. DGM: Working on analogous posts, or a Group 'A' or Group 'B' Gazetted officer working on regular basis in Pay Level 12/ Level 11 from the Civil/Electrical/S&T/Mechanical Engineering Cadre of Indian Railways/Central Govt./ State Govt./ PSUs/Statutory Authority, having a Degree in Civil Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering with 6 years of service in Group 'A'/Group 'B' or its equivalent, or a Diploma in these branches with 15 years' experience. For PSU officers, the IDA pay scale equivalents of CDA Level-13/Level-12/Level-11 are E-6 (Rs.90000-240000), E-5 (Rs.80000-220000) and E-4 (Rs.70000-200000). Manager: Working on an analogous post, or a Group A/Group B officer (Gaz.) working on regular basis in pay level-11/10/09/08 (7th CPC) from the Civil/Electrical/S&T/Mechanical Engineering Cadre of Indian Railways/Central Govt./State Govt./Statutory Authority & PSUs. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Terms of appointment: Normal deputation terms for all three items. Tenure: 5 years (3 years + 2 years). For Manager /Assistant Manager (Projects), the 4th and 5th year are extendable by VC/RLDA. JGM/DGM posts (Items 01 and 02): One scale higher than parent grade is permissible up to Pay Level-12, or deputation allowance if posted in the same grade. Item 01: Railway accommodation/Railway Passes are permissible for Railway Officers; liberal lease facility including self-lease, Conveyance Allowance/Official vehicle, liberal medical facilities, Soft furnishing allowance and electricity allowance are also available. Item 02: Railway accommodation, Railway Passes and TADK are permissible for Railway Officers; liberal lease facility including self-lease, Conveyance Allowance/Official Vehicle, liberal medical facilities, Soft furnishing allowance, Electricity allowance and Caretaker allowance are also available.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RLDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RLDA Vacancy Notice No.-24/2026 lists 6 posts: 1 JGM/DGM (Signal & Telecom/ Extra Low Voltage) at Ahmedabad, 1 JGM/DGM (Project) at Chandigarh and 4 Manager /Assistant Manager (Projects). The numbers are indicative and may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RLDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 5 December 2026 till 17:00 hrs; a posted advance application must reach RLDA on or before that date and time.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the RLDA deputation posts?
faq.answer: Only serving officers of Indian Railways, Central Government, State Government, PSUs or Statutory Authorities who hold the specified cadre, pay level and service for each post can apply, as the posts are filled on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for RLDA Manager /Assistant Manager (Projects)?
faq.answer: Manager needs a Degree in Civil, Electrical, Electronics & Communication or Mechanical Engineering. Assistant Manager needs a Degree in these branches, or a Diploma with 05 years of service, or a 2-year ITI with 10 years of service, while working in Pay Level-7.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for RLDA Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: JGM is in Pay Level-13, DGM in Pay Level-12, Manager in Pay Level-11 and Assistant Manager in Pay Level-9 (7th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for RLDA Vacancy Notice No.-24/2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed Proforma, attach self-attested APARs for the last five years and send it through proper channel to the Dy. General Manager (HR), RLDA, Ajmeri Gate, Delhi-110002; it may also be mailed to [email protected] as a single PDF of up to 20MB.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RLDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interaction/interview, tentatively held at a short notice after 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of RLDA deputation?
faq.answer: The tenure is 5 years (3 years + 2 years) on normal deputation terms; for Manager /Assistant Manager (Projects), the 4th and 5th year are extendable by VC/RLDA.

faq.question: Q9. Do JGM and DGM officers get a higher scale on RLDA deputation?
faq.answer: For the JGM/DGM posts, one scale higher than the parent grade is permissible up to Pay Level-12, or a deputation allowance if posted in the same grade.
